label: PF Backlog 588
title: EDP-07: Provider-neutral storage interfaces (11) + shared conformance test harness (Go)
body: Part of EPIC BI-PF-1292. Source: docs/Product_Forge_Enterprise_Performance_Security_DB_Storage_Roadmap.md. Phase item (see epic). Language rule L1 = Go; must pass scripts/dev/language_rule_review.py.

brief.problem: Storage adapters are being built without a shared contract, risking provider lock-in and inconsistent behavior.
brief.what_adds: Go interfaces for 11 storage operations plus a conformance harness any adapter can validate against.
brief.why: Ensures every storage backend behaves identically, making swaps safe and residency enforcement reliable.
brief.who_feels: Platform engineers building adapters, SREs operating multi-region storage, and security teams verifying isolation.

objective: Define 11 provider-neutral storage interfaces in Go and a reusable conformance test harness that validates any backend adapter against a shared behavioral contract.
acceptance_criteria: 11 Go interfaces defined in internal/storage/ with godoc and compile-time assertions
Conformance harness package exposes embeddable test suites per interface
In-memory reference adapter passes all conformance suites
scripts/dev/language_rule_review.py passes (Go-only)
config/test-matrix.json extended with storage-conformance rows
in_scope: In-memory reference adapter as conformance baseline
approach: Start with ADR-derived interface list, define Go interfaces, build conformance harness with table-driven tests, implement in-memory adapter, wire into test matrix.
verification: Conformance harness detects injected interface violations
All 11 interfaces have at least one conformance suite
risks: Interface over-design leading to churn when S3 adapter (1306) lands
Conformance harness may be too permissive, masking provider-specific bugs
Language rule L1=Go enforced — any deviation caught late in CI
rollback: Revert the internal/storage/ package; no downstream items have merged yet so no integration breakage.
evidence: Candidate components are all Python — confirms no Go storage layer exists
S3 adapter (1306) is an existing dep that will validate these interfaces
Language rule review script exists for Go-only enforcement

analysis.implementation_strategy: Create Go package `internal/storage/` with provider-neutral interfaces (BlobStore, ObjectStore, KeyValueStore, LockStore, QueueStore, CacheStore, FileStore, ArchiveStore, ReplicationStore, MigrationStore, SnapshotStore). Build a shared conformance test harness package `internal/storage/conformance/` that any adapter can embed. No existing Python components are directly reusable; this is new Go infrastructure.
dependency_findings: REQUIRES BI-PF-1293 (architecture ADR) — must be MERGED to pin interface decisions
RELATED BI-PF-1306 (S3 adapter) — S3 adapter will consume these interfaces
RELATED BI-PF-1303 (ResidencyPolicy) — residency checks depend on storage interface hooks
RELATED BI-PF-1297 (Policy Registry) — fail-closed enforcement at storage layer
conflict_findings: BI-PF-1306 (S3 adapter) will create code in same package tree — coordinate interface freeze first
BI-PF-1303 (RegionCell attestation) touches adjacent storage capability surfaces
duplication_findings: No existing Go storage abstraction layer found in candidate components
config/test-matrix.json could be extended to include storage conformance matrix rows
config/shared-paths.json relevant for cross-repo path conventions
analysis.rationale: This is foundational infrastructure enabling all subsequent storage adapter items. New Go components are required because no existing code provides provider-neutral storage interfaces.
assumptions: Storage architecture ADR (1293) defines the canonical interface taxonomy
Postgres is the primary relational backend for this phase
No existing Go storage abstraction in the repository yet
risks: Interface over-design leading to churn when S3 adapter (1306) lands
Conformance harness may be too permissive, masking provider-specific bugs
Language rule L1=Go enforced — any deviation caught late in CI
evidence: Candidate components are all Python — confirms no Go storage layer exists
S3 adapter (1306) is an existing dep that will validate these interfaces
Language rule review script exists for Go-only enforcement
missing_info: Exact list of 11 interfaces — needs confirmation from architecture ADR (1293)
Whether conformance harness runs in CI or only locally
Minimum set of test providers (in-memory, filesystem, Postgres?)

context_review.reason: Foundational item; architecture ADR must land first to lock interface taxonomy, but implementation approach is clear.

consolidation_proposal.title: EDP-07: Provider-neutral storage interfaces (11) + shared conformance test harness (Go)
consolidation_proposal.body: Part of EPIC BI-PF-1292. Source: docs/Product_Forge_Enterprise_Performance_Security_DB_Storage_Roadmap.md. Phase item (see epic). Language rule L1 = Go; must pass scripts/dev/language_rule_review.py.
acceptance_criteria: The 11 interfaces are declared with explicit optional capabilities (versioning/lock/conditional-write/KMS/signed-URL/multipart).
A conformance suite runs against any adapter (starting with WorkerGrid's store as reference).
No domain module depends on a concrete provider.
private buckets, least-privilege credentials, lifecycle/versioning where required; explicit region/backup/replication capability metadata.
Signed URLs only after authorization, constrained to object/method, short TTL.
Provider config stays inside the adapter; conformance suite passes (wrong-region, versions, delete, restore).
ADR document committed covering storage layers, backends, and data-flow decisions
Develop commit SHA pinned and recorded
L1 Go rule passes language_rule_review.py
tenant.home_region, jurisdiction_profile_id, residency_policy_version are set at provisioning from authenticated config (never from X-Tenant-Id/X-Region/URL).
Provisioning fails closed if any required service (DB/object/backup/logs/KMS/queue/cache/vector/workers/model) lacks an approved region.
Region is immutable to ordinary users; changes require an audited migration plan.
Registry versions policies and fails closed on unknown/missing region
IN-v1 and US-v1 profiles load from config and validate
Policy evaluation delegated to BI-PF-1303 interfaces
Go passes language_rule_review.py
